# Canon EDSDK

Place the licensed Windows SDK here during the Windows integration step. SDK binaries
are intentionally ignored. Download from the Canon Europe Developer Programme after
reviewing its terms; do not copy DLLs from the installed dslrBooth application.

The exact SDK version, EOS 4000D firmware, x86/x64 compatibility and permitted redistribution
must be recorded after the first real hardware test. No SDK is included in this repository.
